name: HYDRA-UMC-ANOMALY-DETECTOR
notes: Real FFT + statistical baseline anomaly detector, empirically threshold-tuned against real synthetic healthy/faulty signal separation. Real model versioning (every Verdict carries the model_version/threshold it was scored against), real precision/recall metrics over the labeled synthetic fixture (metrics.py), and simulated drift detection (drift.py's DriftMonitor) for a sustained score-elevation trend distinct from any single window's own anomaly flag.
